info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Party By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to update details of legal entities in the banking system based on specific parameters. By providing a unique identifier, organizations can ensure that their legal entity information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers for this API include financial institutions and compliance departments that need to manage legal records efficiently. This operation supports maintaining regulatory compliance and improves the integrity of business data.

put.summary: Update a legal entity in the directory
put.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific legal entity identified by its unique ID in the legal entity directory. Ensure that you provide all required fields in the request body to successfully update the entity.

requestBody.description: Updates the legal entity details in the directory for the specified RES-100045 identifier. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request body to successfully update the entity.

200.description: The request was completed successfully and the resource was updated.
